query: My CASE CX350B was built in 2010. Which lower radiator hose does the catalog show?
response_text:
The CNH US catalog for the **2010 CASE CX350B** lists four radiator-hose candidates:

- **KSH1065**
- **KSH1029**
- **KSH1031**
- **KSH1032**

However, the catalog evidence I could access does **not identify which one is the lower radiator hose**. The relevant “Radiator and Connections” assembly is here: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/engine/radiator-and-connections/cn/10462E54-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EDA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]. A separate radiator listing shows **LK005320** as “HOSE,” but it is not identified as the lower hose and should not be substituted: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/engine/radiator/cn/1F4AAC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EDA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].

*US catalog coverage includes the 2010 machine, but exact lower-hose fitment remains unverified without the catalog figure/serial-specific confirmation.

query: Find the bucket-link spherical bearing for my CASE CX130 built in 2005.

- **160724A1** — 65 mm ID × 80 mm OD × 65 mm long; quantity 2

query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
For a **1985 CASE W20C**, the catalog lists two possible hydraulic master brake cylinders:

- **N8469 — Hydraulic cylinder**, noted as **“MASTER CYLINDER – brake actuator.”** It requires service kit **N6937**. Assembly: “L107985 and L112959 Brake Actuators.” [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8469]
- **N8695 — Hydraulic cylinder, 200 mm stroke**, also noted as **“MASTER CYLINDER – brake actuator.”** Assembly: “L113007 Brake Actuator.” [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8695]

**N9055** is labeled “master cylinder,” but the catalog identifies it as an **air-chamber assembly for a Midland actuator**, so it should not be assumed to be the hydraulic cylinder. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/master-cylinder/p/N9055]
